page_title: MNT 0-0 REN | Montpellier v Rennes 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Stephanie Frappart is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Rennes will take a corner kick.
90+5' Rennes are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
90+3' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:16.
90+2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' A terrific attempt by Guela Doue (Rennes) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
81' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier) replacing Akor Adams.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wahbi Khazri departs the field of play to be replaced by Sacha Delaye (Montpellier).
81' Enzo Le Fee will be replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
78' Today's referee Stephanie Frappart rightly decides to book Joris Chotard (Montpellier) for his harsh tackle.
76' Substitution. Guela Doue (Rennes) on for Lorenz Assignon.
76' Here is a change. Ibrahim Salah is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Enzo Le Fee (Rennes).
75' Montpellier get a corner.
74' Substitution. Khalil Fayad makes his way off the pitch and Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) comes on as his replacement.
73' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is flagged for offside.

72' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Steve Mandanda. This effort really didn't trouble him.
71' A cross by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
69' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Montpellier for a penalty. Play continues.
68' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

66' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) drives a shot towards the right side of the goal from inside the box, but Benjamin Lecomte leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
65' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Amine Gouiri (Rennes) replaces Bertug Yildirim.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Fabian Rieder (Rennes) is replacing Desire Doue.
61' Crossbar! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
57' Desire Doue (Rennes) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Rennes win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
48' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Desire Doue (Rennes) commits a foul and Stephanie Frappart immediately signals a free kick.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
43' A cross into the box from Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is cleared.

40' A bullet header by Akor Adams (Montpellier) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
38' Akor Adams (Montpellier) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
34' Montpellier take a short corner kick.

34' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Steve Mandanda pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick.
32' The foul by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Stephanie Frappart.
32' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
26' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' Handball by Desire Doue (Rennes). Montpellier are awarded the free kick.
19' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

18' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Benjamin Lecomte guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball is out of play and Rennes manage to earn a corner.

18' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
14' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
13' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Teji Savanier (Montpellier).
9' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' A loose ball is pounced on by Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Benjamin Lecomte is alert and makes a comfortable save.
6' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) inside the box.

4' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
3' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Montpellier are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Stephanie Frappart will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
